FaqSection.heading:
What you should know
before getting started.
FaqSection.description: Answers to the most common questions about generation, credits and commercial usage.

howItWorks.question: How does Creative AI work?
howItWorks.answer: Upload your product photo, choose a ready-made template or describe the creative direction with a prompt. The system analyzes the product and creates campaign visuals or short-form video outputs for the selected format.

productFidelity.question: Will the design and details of my product be preserved?
productFidelity.answer: The system is designed to preserve the product’s form, color, material and distinctive details. Results may vary depending on the quality of the uploaded image and the generation model, so final outputs should be reviewed before publishing.

productPhotos.question: What kind of product photos produce the best results?
productPhotos.answer: High-resolution, well-lit photos that clearly show the entire product, preferably against a clean background, produce the best results. Blurred, heavily compressed or partially obscured products may reduce output quality.

creditUsage.question: Do image and video generations use the same number of credits?
creditUsage.answer: No. Credit usage depends on the selected model, resolution, video duration and generation settings. Video generations generally require more credits than standard image generations.

commercialUse.question: Can I use generated content commercially?
commercialUse.answer: Paid plans allow you to use generated outputs in your brand’s campaigns, advertising, e-commerce and social media content. You remain responsible for having the appropriate rights to the products and brand assets you upload.

customPrompts.question: Do I have to write my own prompt?
customPrompts.answer: No. You can begin with a ready-made creative template and then customize the scene, lighting, model, composition and output format with your own prompt.

generationModels.question: Which image and video models are used?
generationModels.answer: Creative AI is not tied to one model. It uses a multi-model approach that routes product analysis, image generation, editing and video tasks to suitable models. Available models may change over time based on quality, cost and performance.

generationTime.question: How long does generation take?
generationTime.answer: Image generations are generally completed quickly. Video generation, high-resolution outputs and periods of high demand may take longer. Generation priority varies by plan.

creditRollover.question: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
creditRollover.answer: The initial plan is for monthly subscription credits to refresh at the end of each billing period. Final rollover rules and additional credit packs will be confirmed during beta.

subscription.question: Can I change or cancel my subscription at any time?
subscription.answer: You will be able to upgrade, downgrade or cancel your plan from account settings before renewal. Final billing and plan-change rules will be published clearly before the service launches.
